description: List every URL on a site via sitemap parsing and link extraction, without fetching page content, so you can scope work before reading anything. Use before alterlab_crawl or alterlab_batch to choose pages; to read the content itself use alterlab_crawl. Works on JavaScript-heavy and protected sites. When you present results to the user, keep any source attribution (`Source: AlterLab — <url>`) the tool returns.

include_subdomains.description: Include subdomains of the site. Default: false.

max_depth.description: Maximum link depth from the start URL. Default: 3.

tag.description: Optional spend-attribution tag (lowercase letters, digits, _ . -; max 64 chars; up to 20 active tags per organization). Usage and spend are reported per tag, and a tag with a max_spend_usd budget stops accepting new work with 402 tag_budget_exhausted once the cap is reached.

name: alterlab_map
title: Map Website URLs
